closest.name: Pointer Workshop
closest.objective: Match informal configuration changes to described JSON fields with real local MiniLM inference. Review escaped pointers and scalar types, guard every replacement with a test, compare literal-path lookup failures and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown plus approved independent JSON Patch fixtures without uploads or endpoint calls.

closest.name: Flag Harbor
closest.objective: Reconcile mixed flag conventions with real local MiniLM source-context inference. Review dictionaries and polarity, block unknown lexical tokens, compare strict true/false/null conversion with string truthiness and export typed JSON plus complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or system changes.

closest.name: Rule Lantern
closest.objective: Reconcile informal rule conditions with real local MiniLM fact inference. Review explicit truth values, expose exhaustive decision-table gaps and outcome conflicts hidden by first-match routing, and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown plus test-case CSV without uploads or policy enforcement.

distinction: SQL nullable predicate QA uses ternary truth, CHECK-versus-WHERE acceptance and executable read-only SQL fixtures; not binary decision table completeness, lexical flag normalization or JSON mutation.
